session.zh: 跨市场收盘 · 美国 / 香港 9 月 17 日
session.en: Cross-market close · US / Hong Kong Sep 17

headline.zh: 油价与长端利率回落带动美股反弹；联储加息后的港股仍走弱，DRAM 现货分化延续。
headline.en: Lower oil and long yields lifted US equities; Hong Kong remained weaker after the Fed hike while DRAM spot-price dispersion persisted.

summary.zh: 截至上海时间 9 月 18 日早晨，9 月 17 日是美港最近完整交易日。标普 500 上涨 1.1% 至 7,637.76，纳指上涨 1.7% 至 26,418.30。AP 报道布伦特原油下跌 1%，10 年期美债收益率降至 4.93%。恒指下跌 109 点或 0.44% 至 24,604，恒生科技指数下跌 0.34%。TrendForce 的 9 月 17 日现货报价显示 DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 上涨 0.73% 至 55.233 美元，DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 上涨 0.78% 至 46.143 美元，DDR4 16Gb (2Gx8) 3200 下跌 1.85% 至 86.00 美元。
summary.en: As of the morning of September 18 in Shanghai, September 17 was the latest completed US and Hong Kong session. The S&P 500 gained 1.1% to 7,637.76 and the Nasdaq gained 1.7% to 26,418.30. AP reported Brent fell 1% and the 10-year Treasury yield fell to 4.93%. The Hang Seng fell 109 points, or 0.44%, to 24,604 and the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 0.34%. TrendForce's September 17 spot quotes showed DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 up 0.73% to $55.233, DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 up 0.78% to $46.143, and DDR4 16Gb (2Gx8) 3200 down 1.85% to $86.00.

label.zh: 收益率回落带来风险偏好修复
label.en: Lower yields support a risk-appetite repair

title.zh: 长端利率回落有利于估值敏感资产，但单日反弹不改变加息后的融资约束。
title.en: Lower long yields help valuation-sensitive assets, but a one-day rebound does not remove post-hike financing constraints.

detail.zh: 油价、10 年期收益率和美股同步变化是已确认事实；将其解读为折现率缓和是分析判断，并不预测通胀、政策或企业盈利。
detail.en: The moves in oil, the 10-year yield and US equities are confirmed facts; reading them as easing discount-rate pressure is analysis, not a forecast of inflation, policy or earnings.

label.zh: 美国 10 年期国债收益率 · Sep 17

title.zh: 油价和长端利率回落支持美股反弹
title.en: Lower oil and long yields support a US equity rebound

detail.zh: AP 报道布伦特原油下跌 1%，10 年期美债收益率降至 4.93%；标普 500 上涨 85.95 点至 7,637.76，纳指上涨 439.87 点至 26,418.30。该组合缓和估值压力，但不单独决定通胀、政策或企业盈利。
detail.en: AP reported Brent fell 1% and the 10-year Treasury yield fell to 4.93%; the S&P 500 gained 85.95 points to 7,637.76 and the Nasdaq gained 439.87 points to 26,418.30. The combination eases valuation pressure but does not by itself determine inflation, policy or earnings.

title.zh: 港股仍受加息后风险偏好影响
title.en: Hong Kong remains affected by post-hike risk appetite

detail.zh: RTHK 报道恒指下跌 0.44% 至 24,604，科技指数下跌 0.34%。单日指数变化不能替代对 0700.HK AI 回报或 9992.HK 海外执行的基本面验证。
detail.en: RTHK reported the Hang Seng fell 0.44% to 24,604 and the tech index fell 0.34%. One-day index moves do not substitute for validating 0700.HK's AI returns or 9992.HK's overseas execution.

title.zh: 美股 AI 风险偏好回升不是基本面结论
title.en: Improved US AI risk appetite is not a fundamental conclusion

detail.zh: 纳指上涨 1.7%，但一日反弹不能证明 AAPL、GOOGL 或 MSFT 的 AI 变现、利润率或资本回报发生变化；这些仍需公司披露和经营数据验证。
detail.en: The Nasdaq gained 1.7%, but a one-day rebound does not prove a change in AI monetization, margins or capital returns at AAPL, GOOGL or MSFT; these still need company disclosures and operating evidence.

title.zh: DRAM 现货继续分化，不能直接外推周期
title.en: DRAM spot pricing remains mixed and cannot define the cycle

detail.zh: TrendForce 的 9 月 17 日现货页显示 DDR5 16Gb 与 DDR4 8Gb 上涨，而 DDR4 16Gb 下跌 1.85%。日度现货变化不是合约价格、HBM 盈利、出货或 DRAM 基金回报的替代指标。
detail.en: TrendForce's September 17 spot page showed DDR5 16Gb and DDR4 8Gb higher while DDR4 16Gb fell 1.85%. Daily spot moves are not substitutes for contract pricing, HBM profitability, shipments or DRAM ETF returns.
